profile: Researcher and developer working on machine learning for architectural design. Current research applies graph neural networks and deep metric learning to correspondence between building representations at different scales, and extends to LLM agents for parametric modeling; the part-to-whole modeling method underlying this research is the subject of a pending US patent. A parallel line of work develops exact solvers for residential layout. Earlier research in Polyhedral Graphic Statics at the University of Pennsylvania produced a glass bridge exhibited at the Corning Museum of Glass.

work.progression_summary: Designer track, joined as Junior Designer

blocks.heading: Natalie: Computational Design Platform
blocks.intro: Primary engineer across the stack: React front end, solver and ML core, Rhino and Revit integration, encrypted distribution, telemetry, and release. Funded by SOM IW, a firm subsidiary, after review by a committee of Partners; 25 production releases since 2023; in routine use on live projects across 8 offices worldwide. Proprietary to SOM; publications extract the generalizable methods.

entries.name: Facade propagation
entries.desc: Siamese heterogeneous graph attention network transferring facade systems from prototype to massing, trained with pair-local label supervision so correspondence needs no shared label vocabulary across scales; TorchSharp inference in live Rhino sessions. 2.6M facade modules populated on live projects.

entries.name: Residential planner
entries.desc: Backtracking search over a slicing-tree representation; touch adjacencies gated in search, reach adjacencies discharged by routing hallways; every rule re-verified on final geometry.

entries.name: Unit-mix planner
entries.desc: Exact MILP for unit stacking and mix across residential massings; certifies feasibility or diagnoses why none exists.

entries.name: Web portal
entries.desc: Browser version of the platform on the same solver backend, in use by studio heads and partners on live projects to prototype with clients in the meeting room, no Rhino seat required; residential planner and unit-mix solver rewritten in Rust from the Rhino-command originals and compiled to WebAssembly.

entries.name: Rhino–Revit bridge
entries.desc: Context-based porting into live Revit via Rhino.Inside: blocks arrive as placed families, planar surfaces as levels and floors — semantics survive the port.

blocks.heading: Research Initiatives
blocks.intro: Formal internal SOM research: three-month staffed sprints on massing intelligence, layout representation, and agentic modeling, presented to Partners and C-suite.

work.org: Polyhedral Structures Laboratory, University of Pennsylvania
